searchUrls.title: Redfin search URLs
searchUrls.description: Any Redfin search page: city, neighborhood, county or ZIP, with any filters you set on redfin.com, e.g. https://www.redfin.com/city/30818/TX/Austin/filter/include=sold-3mo,min-beds=3

zipCodes.title: US ZIP codes (optional)
zipCodes.description: Five-digit ZIP codes, e.g. 78704. Uses the listing type and filters below.

listingType.title: Listing type (for ZIP codes)
listingType.description: For-sale listings, or homes sold in a time window. Search URLs keep their own setting.

splitLargeSearches.title: Get past the 350-home cap
splitLargeSearches.description: Redfin returns at most 350 homes per search. When a search hits that cap, split it into price bands and fetch each one.

trackChanges.title: Track price changes between runs
trackChanges.description: Remember each home's price and status, and add previousPrice, priceChange, previousStatus and isNew to every row. Built for scheduled runs.

onlyChanges.title: Only return new or changed homes
onlyChanges.description: With tracking on, skip homes whose price and status have not changed since the last run. Unchanged homes are not charged.

maxHomes.title: Max homes per run
maxHomes.description: Cap on home rows returned. Controls total cost.
